page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with running head above and catchword at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: instar carbonis candentis fulgens : Amethystus, ex puniceo colore fulgens : Asterites, sub crystallino colore albo Lunæ faciem fulgentem ostentans.

Pofterioris generis sunt : Rubinus, gemma purpurea, in tenebris instar scintillæ micans : Topazius, aurei coloris, Soli exposita radios spargens: Hyacinthus, coloris aquei, interdiu fulgens, in tenebris nebulosa.

head.i: Atq; ad ista digitum intendisse sufficiat: agendum etiam de iis quæ per putrefactionem oriuntur.

main_text.p: Putrefactio est, quando partes terreæ in aqueo copioso consistentes, calore externo in ipso humido crassescente rarefiunt ; atq; ita utraq; ob pugnam primarum qualitatum corruptionem quandam experiuntur.
unde plerunq; initiò ingratum odorem pu-trescentia de se mittunt.
Bruta corpora per putrefactionem genita sunt, mine-ralia & metalla.
Mineralia, quorum humidū supra terreum siccum exsuperat : Sal, alumen; & bitumen.
Sal est minerale, ex pauciore terreo, in copiosiore aqueo minùs crasso, per vehementè calore adusto, & cum eo indurato, genitum.
unde Sal humido frigido potissimùm facile liquescit.
Sal in terris aliud, aliud in aquis nascitur.

page.notes: Decorative flourish before "Atq;" in the heading is ornament, not text. Small mark at the foot centre is uncertain and is recorded as a possible signature "4[?]". Catchword "In" sits at the lower right. The line "unde plerunq;" and the word "putrescentia" are split at a line end with a printed hyphen, kept as printed. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout, including where it resembles f in "trescentia" and "crasso" as printed.
